vibe_rationale: Real riding scene with a family atmosphere, but built around a 120-plus exhibitor expo and heavily sponsor-branded.
fit_notes: Adult riders plus families over five days on the NSW South Coast, with a clear active-lifestyle angle and a named managing director for partnerships. Brands are already well represented, so a health brand would be one of many; CamelBak (hydration) is the closest precedent. An expo stall or sampling is the low-barrier route, and community depth is lower than a club scene.
